A '''firebeetle''' was a type of flesh-eating [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] that lived on [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. They were exterminated from the populated areas of Taanab about thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but still lived in the more remote areas of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], like [[Ba-Taanab Peninsula]]. In [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] fell into a firebeetle pit there and was almost eaten alive, although was able to escape unharmed. He later had a [[Dream/Legends|dream]] about them in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
